Author: XivHub
Name: RetainerReach
Punchline: Unified retainer inventory grid with one-click retrieve. Requires AllaganTools.
Description: REQUIRES AllaganTools (a.k.a. Allagan Market / InventoryTools) installed and enabled — RetainerReach reads your retainer inventories from it. Unified view of your active character and all retainers' inventories as an in-game-style icon grid, with one-click Retrieve that summons each holding retainer at a nearby Summoning Bell and pulls selected items into your bags. Search by name, filter by category or crafting material, save recurring pulls as presets, and retrieve from chat via /retrieve. This plugin automates in-game actions (retainer bell interaction and item retrieval) on your behalf; use at your own risk with respect to the game's Terms of Service.
